allot.text: N. B. I. Industrial Finance Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on January 17, 2025. The Board has fixed the record date as Wednesday, January 29, 2025 for allotment of shares to Shareholders of western India Commercial Co. Ltd. pursuant to order of the Hon'ble NCLT sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation.
